name: Staffstrike, Lesser
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F quarterstaff, magic staff, or walking stick

EFFECT

Range 15 ft.
Area cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Slamming your staff on the ground you send forth shockwaves dealing 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage and 2d6 points of sonic damage to all creatures and objects within the area. Living creatures are deafened for 1d4 rounds; a successful Fortitude save negates the deafness and reduces the damage by half.
